definition: used to introduce a particular case showing an idea
sentence: Many fruits are sweet, for example, apples.

definition: used to say something is expected or readily agreed
sentence: Of course, I can help you.

definition: used to introduce a new or additional topic
sentence: By the way, where is your bag?

definition: at the beginning of a period or situation
sentence: At first, the puzzle is difficult.

definition: finally, after other things have happened
sentence: In the end, we find the key.

definition: early enough for a particular purpose
sentence: We arrive in time to catch the bus.

definition: for a short period
sentence: Wait here for a moment.

definition: continually or very frequently
sentence: He talks about football all the time.

definition: on the first occasion something happens
sentence: He rides a bike for the first time.

definition: starting now and continuing into the future
sentence: From now on, I will check my work.

definition: used when a past situation has ended
sentence: He no longer lives here.

definition: in addition; also
sentence: She has a book as well.

definition: in place of someone or something else
sentence: We drink water instead of juice.

definition: as a result of a particular cause
sentence: The picnic is cancelled because of rain.

definition: because of something that happened before
sentence: It rains. As a result, we stay inside.

definition: deliberately rather than accidentally
sentence: He moves the chair on purpose.

definition: immediately after something happens
sentence: I will call you as soon as I get home.
context: Then, I call you right away.

definition: used to add a fact or correct an idea
sentence: The bag looks heavy. In fact, it is very light.
context: In fact, it is very light.

definition: used before examples
sentence: I like fruit such as apples and bananas.
context: I like fruit such as apples and bananas.

definition: used to explain the purpose of an action
sentence: Speak slowly so that I can understand.
context: Speak slowly so that I can understand.

definition: whether or not a possible condition happens
sentence: I will go even if it rains.
context: I will go even if it rains.

definition: only if a particular condition is met
sentence: You can borrow it as long as you bring it back.
context: You can borrow it as long as you bring it back.

definition: before an event or action
sentence: Please book your ticket in advance.
context: Please book your ticket in advance.

definition: whatever happens or whatever the situation is
sentence: I will help you, no matter what.
context: I will help you, no matter what.

definition: at the final part of a place, event or period
sentence: The shop is at the end of the street.
context: The shop is at the end of the street.

definition: at the first part of an event or period
sentence: We have a meeting at the beginning of each week.
context: We have a meeting at the beginning of each week.

definition: because something might happen
sentence: Take an umbrella in case it rains.
context: Take an umbrella in case it rains.
